title: Barbie Match Master
description: Play as your favorite Barbie characters in this exciting match-3 puzzle game, Barbie Match Master! Remove tiles from play by making sets of three or more of the same kind. Youll get access to more playable characters and levels as you make your way through the game. Moreover, you may compete with your friends to see who can achieve the highest score.
instructions: Desktop Use the right click button of the mouse to match 3 or more barbies Mobile Click and connect to match 3 or more barbies Controls and Indicators The scores and levels are shown in the upper middle of the screen
